"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America was ready to respond as the new democracies of Central Europe chose freedom.",

"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"It is in America's interest that the new European democracies become fully integrated into the economic, political, and security institutions of the Trans-Atlantic community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These countries are today making great progress toward developing the market economies and democratic political systems that are the best way to ensure both their long-term stability and their security.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The enlargement of NATO to include other nations with democratic values, pluralist political systems, and free market economies should continue.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Neither geographical nor historical circumstances shall dictate the future of a Europe whole and free.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Russia must never be given a veto over enlargement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
